blocks.text: The scenery changes completely several times on this journey, with time to get to know each place. Cusco and Machu Picchu each get a day of their own, the drive to Puno includes sightseeing stops, and you spend a full day at Lake Titicaca. Three days in the Amazon include a lodge stay and outings on the river. After visiting the capital and flying to Cusco, you reach elevations above 3,000 metres and explore archaeological sites and Inca stone architecture. From there, the road leads to Lake Titicaca, where life is shaped by the water and the traditions of local communities. The final stretch takes you to Heliconia Amazon River Lodge for boat outings, tropical forest, birds, pink river dolphins, giant Victoria water lilies and a night walk in the jungle.
